question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Sanjeev is always __busy__ with his business activities.
solution:
The correct answer is '**idle**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Busy**' means having a great deal to do or engaged with. (व्यस्त)

 
 
• **Example**: He is too **busy **with his work to play with his kids.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym of '**busy**' in this context is '**idle**'. '**Idle**' means not active or in use or without purpose or effect; pointless. (खाली or बेकार)
 
 
• **Example**: I don't want to be **idle**, I prefer to be busy and productive.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 3**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, '**active**', means engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits. (सक्रिय)
 
• Option 2, '**engaged**', means busy; occupied. (व्यस्त)
 
• Option 4, '**enthusiastic**', means showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साही)
